correctness.rationale: The exact derivative equations give 12 nodes, all analytically uv+w^2=0. Coordinate-plane conics factor as two distinct F4-lines, giving 8. On any other line all four coordinate linear forms are nonzero, their product is a square, so they divide into two proportional pairs. The coefficient equations force both pair ratios to be roots of z²+z+1, yielding exactly 12 more lines. Exact exhaustive standard-library F4 checker separately reproduces the twenty lines, twelve nodes, 72 nodal and 22 distinct smooth crossings, and Frobenius pairs. The finite checker proves the finite incidence statement; algebraic coefficient comparison proves completeness over the algebraic closure.

value.rationale: A complete line configuration, nodal and smooth incidence geometry, and rational descent are naturally significant invariants of a symmetric 12-nodal quartic K3 model. The new line-Hilbert support and precise 190-pair intersection classification are not tautological from the classical singularity basket, and the zeta function records arithmetic structure of the line configuration. The focus is the natural symmetric model, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
